newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products close lower as soybeans fall.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products close lower as soybeans fall.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed lower on a slide in soybeans, traders said.
A drop this week in exports and export rumors, bearish technical signals and prospects for USDA in November to increase its estimate for the U.S. soybean crop hit prices, they said.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 16,000 contracts, down from 17,296 Tuesday, according to the CBOT. Soyoil options volume was estimated at 500 contracts, down from 1,097 Tuesday.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 20,000 contracts, down from 21,807 Tuesday. Soymeal options volume was estimated at 1,000 contracts, down from 1,500 Tuesday.
Soyoil closed 0.03 to 0.16 cent per lb lower, with December down 0.16 at 22.94. Soymeal was $4.50 per ton lower to $0.50 higher, with December down $2.30 at $226.60.
